notes.title: Release note from developer
notes.content:
Hi, 

Thanks for checking Primitive Road out. This is my first indie VR game and I'm still in exploring on how to make better VR experience like many other developers. So whether you like or dislike this game, feel free to leave your comment and I'll follow as much as possible. Cheers.
